Bigg Boss Telugu 10 के सेट पर हुआ एक जबरदस्त सरप्राइज वाला खुलासा! 😲

Bigg Boss Telugu 10 के मंच पर Rashmika Mandanna पहुंचीं तो वहां एक चौंकाने वाला पल देखने को मिला।

जब Mukesh Gowda सामने आए, तो Rashmika Mandanna को अचानक पता चला कि वह तो उनके college senior रह चुके हैं!

अपने ही कॉलेज सीनियर को इस तरह शो में देखकर Rashmika Mandanna पूरी तरह से हैरान रह गईं।

कॉलेज के दिनों की यादों के बीच अभिनेत्री ने बात करते हुए कहा 'I used to...'! 🎬

क्या आपको भी कभी अपने college senior से जुड़ा ऐसा ही कोई सरप्राइज मिला है? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

#RashmikaMandanna #MukeshGowda #BiggBossTelugu10 #CineChaska #BollywoodNews #Tollywood Updates

ctx.title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10: Rashmika Mandanna gets surprised when Mukesh Gowda turns out to be her college senior, says ‘I used to…’
ctx.summary:
Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, hosted by Nagarjuna Akkineni, recently welcomed Rashmika Mandanna as a special guest. The actress appeared on the show ahead of her upcoming film Mysaa and was pleasantly surprised to discover that contestant Mukesh Gowda had been her senior in college. 
 Bigg Boss Telugu 10: Rashmika Mandanna gets a blast from the past when Mukesh Gowda reveals their college connection 
 During the weekend episode,  Nagarjuna Akkineni  introduced Rashmika to all the housemates. Addressing Mukesh, he said, “Rashmika is here. Go ahead and speak to her in Mysuru Kannada or Bengaluru Kannada, whatever you want.” 
 After exchanging pleasantries, Mukesh revealed, “You were my junior in college.” Surprised by the revelation, Rashmika listened as he further explained, “My friends used to study with you, and I saw you there.” 
 Mukesh Gowda is best known for playing the lead role in the television show Guppedantha Manasu, which airs on Star Maa. 
 Rashmika Mandanna’s work front 
 Rashmika Mandanna  was last seen in the lead role in Ranabaali, co-starring Vijay Deverakonda. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the period action drama follows a 19th-century warrior who clashes with colonial authorities, alongside his wife and trusted allies. 
 The film features The Mummy fame Arnold Vosloo as the main antagonist, with Lal, Easwari Rao, Sheela Rajkumar, and others appearing in key roles. Upon its release, the film received mixed reviews.
